annotations.title: Cheefe Priests.
annotations.text: [1] Heretikes abuse the ignorant people with these naughtie Priests of the old Testament, to make that name odious, and to discredite the Priests of Christ in the new Testament. But for these Priests, thou maist not maruel that they are so busy against Christ, [2] partly because they were such as were intruded by the secular power of the Roman Emperour, and from yere to yere by bribery and frendship, not by succession according to the Law of Moyses: partly because the time was now come when the old Priesthod of Aaron should cease, and the new begin according to the order of Melchisedec: and for these causes God suffered their former priueleges of wisedom and iudgement and discretion to decay in these later vsurpers, and that according to the Prophet saying, [3] The Law shal perish from the Priest and counsel from the Ancients. [4] But the Priesthod of the new Testament is to continew vnto the end of the world, and hath (as being the principal part of the Church) the assistance of the Holy Ghost for euer promised, to teach it al truth: [5]and for Peter the cheefe Priest thereof vnder Christ, our Sauiour praied, That his faith should not faile: and to the rest he said, He that heareth you, heareth me.

notes.text: The Priests of the old Testament.
Euseb. Ec. Hist. li. 1 c. 6. ex Iosepho.
The Priesthod of the new Testament.

annotations.title: To satisfie the people.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Pilate should haue suffered death, rather then by other mens prouocation or commaundement haue executed an innocent: as a Christian iudge should rather suffer al extremitie, then giue sentence of death against a Catholike man for his faith.

annotations.title: Bying sindon.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This dutie done to Christes body after his departure, was exceding meritorious, and is therfore by holy write so often commended for an example to faithful men, to vse al honour and deuotion towards the bodies of Saincts and holy persons.

notes.text: Religious duty toward the bodies of Christ and his Saincts.
